item.title: 30 Aug: Texas Governor Abbott blocks funding for more Flock cameras
item.description: • Texas Governor Abbott blocks funding for more Flock cameras • Faro raises thirty-seven point three million dollars • California exempts open-source operating systems from age-verification law • Musk's faster path to more gas turbines comes with pollution problem • The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launches
